[the1doood] I read somewhere on this forum about potential ban on imported phones by carriers. I had a good perfectly working 5G phone bought from Spain blacklisted by all carriers few months ago and hopefully such things doesn't happen again.
[DrScavenger] Wait they can do that? IMEI registration? Feels like that would be by the government not carriers
[Pandaboss] Yes IMEI block. Its due to the 000 issue.
Check you phone and see an update will bypass this block. Then check if your actually supports the required Bands . Think its 28.
Ive got a good working import Samsung Note20 Ultra 5G and had old firmware. Updated and the voice prompt before everycall was gone in a couple days.
[Deathdefy] Note that sadly simple actual compliance with the required band isn't the test.
It's insanely arbitrary and depends on Voda/Optus/Telstra having checked that model themselves. The definitive (publicly sourced) list is https://isthisphoneblocked.net.au/ and the Nothing 3 is gold on both Telstra and Optus.
My experience from a different phone (Ulefone Armour 34 Pro Plus) is that silence/unknown on Vodafone means it's actually blocked.
I spoke in store and they weren't against attempting to add it, but couldn't do it in the few days I needed it done within as I was heading overseas.
Short version - if you're with Voda/a Voda carrier and get this phone, be ready to port.
[DrScavenger] @Deathdefy: This is absolutely ridiculous, and looks like a legislation issue not even companies being evil
[OZKap] @DrScavenger: Surely Telcos (who sell their own phones) have no incentive to fearmonger and block grey imports 😇

looks like a legislation issue
Legislating intelligence
[braddsey] My son’s iphone 11 got blocked when they first started this silliness. We got him a local replacement which he used for about 12 months until he dropped it and killed face id (which made it useless). Got the original phone out again, and it works again. He periodically gets some annoying Telstra message, but no issues.
[timhn] My iPhone 11 is working fine with a Telstra SIM. Haven't seen any messages from Telstra except telling me to recharge.
[timhn] Insane price but big risk if buying phones outside Australia without confirm with 3 Telco that they will not block your device.
[happyangus] We really get ripped off here huh, that local price at $999 is outrageous. And that is when it's on "sale" no less
[ak98] Using this phone now, honestly at that price it is a great device. Nothing OS is a seriously well made skin for android, lightweight, unique and fast. The phone itself is well built, a bit on the heavy side and also thicker than most other flagships. It has average battery life, but perfomance is snappy and better than I expected. The chipset inside is about equivalent to a Snapdragon 8 gen 2 or 3, so basically a 2023 flagship phone chip. At its launch price that was an awful deal, but at this price it's definitely worth considering!
